app.name: Daftarak
app.tagline: Your shop's ledger, on your phone, offline

welcome.title: Welcome to Daftarak
welcome.body: Sales, stock, customers and suppliers — all on your phone, working without internet.
welcome.point3: Your data is encrypted on your phone

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.body: We'll text you a 6-digit code. Internet is needed only this time.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.invalid: This number isn't valid. Use an Egyptian or Saudi mobile number.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{s}} s

chooseBusiness.title: Your business
chooseBusiness.body: This number already has a business.
chooseBusiness.existingWarning: The old phone becomes read-only. Old data moves over once backup & restore ships (soon). Until then this phone starts empty.

business.title: Tell us about your shop
business.name: Shop or company name
business.vatHint: If not, no tax is printed on your invoices.

owner.title: Your owner account
owner.body: The PIN locks the app on this phone. Every employee gets their own PIN.
owner.name: Your name
owner.weak: That PIN is easy to guess, pick another

lock.title: Who's using the app?
lock.lockedFor: Locked for now. Try again in {{time}}

home.nextPhaseTitle: Selling and products arrive in the next update
home.nextPhaseBody: The foundation is ready: account, lock, users and licence. Products, selling and printing come in the next phase.

licence.grace: Your subscription ended. {{days}} days left before moving to the free plan.
licence.readOnly: The app is view-only right now — you can view, print and export.

reason.offline_too_long: This phone hasn't been online for more than 30 days. Connect once to restore everything.
reason.clock_rollback: The phone clock went backwards. Fix date & time and connect once.
reason.deactivated: This account was opened on another phone, so this one is view-only.
reason.suspended: The account is suspended. Contact us.
reason.no_licence: Please sign in again with your mobile code.
reason.invalid: There is a problem with the app licence. Connect once.
reason.wrong_device: This licence belongs to another phone.

licence.limit: You reached your plan's limit. Subscribe to increase it.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.lastOwner: At least one owner must stay active
users.noPermission: You don't have permission for this. Ask the manager.

language.restart: The app will restart to change direction.

subscription.offline: No internet right now — we'll retry later. Your work continues normally.

errors.network: No internet connection. Check it and try again.
errors.invalid_phone: This number isn't valid. Use an Egyptian or Saudi mobile number.
errors.otp_cooldown: Please wait before requesting a new code.
errors.otp_rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.otp_invalid: Wrong code. Check it and try again.
errors.otp_expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
errors.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Request a new code.
errors.otp_send_failed: We couldn't send the SMS. Try again shortly.
errors.dbNotEncrypted: This build has no database encryption, so it won't run to protect your data.

audit.intact: The log is intact — nothing was edited
audit.broken: The log was edited at entry #{{seq}}
